title: Aerobic run + spin (Thu skip recovered)
terrain: flat to rolling, D+ under 100m, then indoor bike
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 60min run at 138-150bpm, cadence 172+, then 30min spin at 120-135bpm within 2h.
GYM: Copenhagen 2x30s/side.
FUEL: water; 500ml Tailwind on the bike if Sat ran over 2h15.
STOP RULE: quads sore, replace the run with 75min spin at 120-135bpm (total 105min bike).
WHY: the 30min spin carries Thu's missed 35 load at zero impact on day 2 of the back-to-back.
